Subject: Quick recap + next steps (SOC 2 + VPC/on-prem discussion)

Hi Alec / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary:
- Acme is evaluating Redwood for private inference (VPC + on-prem options) for PII-heavy workflows; priority is network isolation and documented evidence for SOC 2 / GDPR controls.
- Primary concerns: where data rests during inference, role-based access to models, and evidence for SOC 2 scope (security & availability).

Action items (proposed):
1) I'll share our SOC 2 summary and a VPC deployment diagram showing control plane vs data plane separation (attached).
2) If you're open, we can initiate the vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) — I attached a templated workbook Acme can use; happy to pre-fill sections we can.
3) Lauren (cc) will follow up on the on-prem / air-gapped packaging details and timelines.
4) Let's target a technical sync next week to walk through the deployment diagram and any SSQ items.

Please let me know availability — happy to accommodate US mornings or late afternoons.

Best,
Marcus

- SOC 2: We currently require a SOC 2 report covering Security and Availability. Do you have the latest report or a SoA we can review? The SOC 2 summary you attached looks helpful but our compliance folks will want the formal report or an auditor letter if possible.

- On-prem / air-gapped: Our architecture team wants to understand what parts of Redwood can be deployed fully air-gapped vs what requires outbound connectivity (if any). The diagram helps but we'll need a short runbook or checklist for an air-gapped install.

Availability: Wed 12/1 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 12/2 14:00–15:00 PT both work for us.

Regards,

- SOC 2 report: attaching the SOC 2 Type II redacted report and a one-page SoA summary (redwood_sso_soc2_summary.pdf). If your team needs the auditor contact for verification, Stephanie (cc) can provide.

Lauren will walk through the packaging and the checklist.

Next steps before the call:
- Alec/Priya: review attached SOC 2 summary and SSQ template; flag top 5 SSQ items you want pre-filled.
- Lauren: prepare an air-gapped deployment checklist + a short slide showing which components must remain isolated vs optional connections.
- Stephanie: please reply with the auditor contact and any redaction guidance for the SOC 2 PDF.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

Looping in compliance notes for the thread so Alec/Priya have context ahead of the call: 

- Auditor contact: You can reach our SOC 2 auditor (Kestrel Audit LLP) at soc2@kestrelaudit.com; they can confirm scope and date ranges. Provide the redacted report and we'll provide a signed letter if needed.
- Redaction guidance: Remove customer names from internal test examples and redact IP addresses in logs; leave control descriptions intact. We typically provide a redacted PDF and an auditor attestation letter for enterprise reviews.
- SSQ process: We recommend a two-pass approach — (1) we pre-fill low-risk architecture and network items; (2) your security team reviews high-risk control questions row-by-row during the technical sync. This speeds turnaround.

Happy to join the call if you want legal/compliance to be present — otherwise I'll be on standby.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Legal & Compliance | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
